balance.label: Balance — feet planted, body moves
balance.note: Nothing commands a joint angle. Every frame says only “put the body here”; the IK solves all twelve.

walk.label: Walk forward — crawl gait
walk.note: One foot up at a time, body leaning over the support triangle before each lift. Statically stable throughout.

turn.label: Turn in place
turn.note: Same code as walking. Yaw rate alone, no forward speed — the ω×r term makes each foot sweep its own arc.

arc.label: Walk and turn together
arc.note: Outside legs automatically take longer strides. No dedicated turning code exists anywhere.

strafe.label: Strafe sideways
strafe.note: Pure lateral command. The legs never change role — only the velocity vector does.

trot.label: Trot — dynamic, diagonal pairs
trot.note: Two feet down means the support polygon is a line: there is no statically stable pose at all. Fast, and always falling. Needs a balance controller to be real.

knees-fwd.label: Knees forward — for comparison
knees-fwd.note: The same walk with every knee mirrored to the front. Identical stability; the difference is that the knee now leads into whatever the robot walks toward, instead of the foot reaching out ahead of it.

unstable.label: The same crawl with the lean switched off
unstable.note: shift_gain = 0. Identical gait otherwise. The centre of mass leaves the support triangle and it tips — this is what four legs do without a body shift.
